name: responsibid
description: Create and price home-service quotes in ResponsiBid. Browse a company's service catalog, look up or add contacts by phone, build bids with property and service details, calculate pricing, and review or select proposal packages. Admins can also set up pricing (house sizes, option prices, packages, bundles) and rewrite follow-up sequences.
